detail.longDescription: I have a textarea to write text in multiple language; for each language user has to end text with two brackets and two letters in it for each language. For example: L'aereo era in pista.[it] The aircraft was on runway.[en] I need to capture text and two lang letters inside brackets. I'm using the following regex in JavaScript: /(.*?)(?=\[([a-zA-Z]{2})\])/gm Regex101 The code doesn't allow me to capture multi-line code, like in the example below: L'aereo era in attesa. In pista pronto al decollo.[it] The aircraft was on runway. Ready to take off.[en] How to fix the issue?
